mapper.select: SELECT YEAR, TERM FROM ( SELECT YEAR, TERM FROM TBL_TEAM ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(YEAR) DESC, TO_NUMBER(TERM) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT DISTINCT YEAR, TERM FROM TBL_TEAM ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(YEAR) DESC, TO_NUMBER(TERM) DESC
SELECT TEAM_NUM, TEAM_NAME, YEAR, TERM, USER_ID, INTRO, REG_DATE FROM TBL_TEAM WHERE YEAR = #{year} AND TERM = #{term} ORDER BY TEAM_NUM DESC

SELECT M.MENTORING_NUM, M.TITLE, M.CONTENT, M.REG_DATE, M.VIEW_COUNT, M.TEAM_NUM, M.WEEKLY_NUM, M.USER_ID, W.WEEK_NAME, F.FILE_NAME AS thumbFileName FROM TBL_MENTORING M JOIN TBL_WEEKLY W ON M.WEEKLY_NUM = W.WEEKLY_NUM LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MENTORING_NUM, FILE_NAME FROM ( SELECT MF.MENTORING_NUM, MF.FILE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY MF.MENTORING_NUM ORDER BY MF.FILE_NUM ASC ) AS RN FROM TBL_MENTORING_FILE MF WHERE LOWER(MF.FILE_NAME) LIKE '%.jpg' OR LOWER(MF.FILE_NAME) LIKE '%.jpeg' OR LOWER(MF.FILE_NAME) LIKE '%.png' OR LOWER(MF.FILE_NAME) LIKE '%.gif' OR LOWER(MF.FILE_NAME) LIKE '%.webp' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) F ON F.MENTORING_NUM = M.MENTORING_NUM WHERE M.TEAM_NUM = #{value} ORDER BY M.MENTORING_NUM DESC
